title: Roof Replacement in Gresham, OR
summary: In September 2024, French Roofing replaced the roof on a home in Gresham, OR. The crew tore off the old roofing down to the wood deck, laid synthetic underlayment, and installed CertainTeed Landmark shingles in Moire Black with new flashings, new attic vents and standard ridge cap.
scope: Tore off all layers of old roofing down to the wood deck
Installed Safeguard 30 synthetic underlayment over the deck
New painted drip edge and gable flashing, plus a self-sealing starter course
Installed CertainTeed Landmark shingles in Moire Black, with woven valleys and standard ridge cap
New front wall and sidewall flashing, new power pole flashing and new double-seal vent pipe flashings
Replaced the attic vents with new plastic vents
Cleaned out the gutters, hauled away the debris and ran a magnet over the yard

faqs.question: What color shingles went on this Gresham roof?
faqs.answer: CertainTeed Landmark in Moire Black, finished with standard ridge cap.

faqs.question: Was the old roof removed first?
faqs.answer: Yes. All layers of old roofing came off down to the wood deck before the synthetic underlayment and new shingles went on.
